note: CShapes holds 860 as a colony of Portugal to 1976-07-16, and this date is that boundary. Restored in M53: `east-timor` begins 2002, twenty-six years later, and this relation does not say who held the ground between — the atlas names nobody for it. Under the owner’s rule of 17 September a succession may be written across a gap; the gap is named here rather than left to make the relation unwritable.
